scope: M1 physical frontend feasibility diagnostic using M3 fixed-GT-opportunity definition; NOT semantic replay/M9, training, threshold selection, main freeze or full feature cache
why_new_not_repeat: Completed full physical audit preserved per-video coverage counts but discarded target-level geometry matches needed for fixed cross-video opportunity support. Reconstruct only that join once, persist evaluator-only; do not rerun physical models, HOTA or features.
fixed_geometry_rule: Unchanged category-free per-video temporal-IoU Hungarian; reliability >=0.5; same input order as completed full audit and reproduce every per-video Known/Novel coverage count
order_generation: Existing registered_orders: sorted full video IDs, independent random.Random(1027/1028/1029).shuffle
support_definition: For each fixed GT cross-video Novel opportunity, both current reliable predicted identity and some reliable identity of the same GT category in a strictly earlier video have at least p annotated observations. Posthoc prerequisite support only, not a prediction, purity certificate or semantic correctness score.
short_track_boundary: Counts >=p describe full-p physical evidence availability ONLY; production prefixes still min(p, observed_length) and all short/missing targets remain in denominators. No row/category/video filtering or model threshold change.
gt_annotation_use: Separate post-seal evaluator only; private geometry join MUST NOT enter any feature encoder, prototype/memory/model, training, sampling or parameter choice
publish: Small aggregate count/rate tables, receipt hashes, tests/source only; numeric target IDs/geometry join stays private; no boxes, GT payload, semantic names or feature arrays
